# BLOND

BLOND is a Design Services company. BLOND is an industrial design agency based in London. They offer design consulting, branding, UX UI, and packaging services. They have been ranked top product design consultancy for Red Dot Awards. BLOND employs 19 people (+42.9% YoY, +12 people), founded in 2014. Headquartered in London, United Kingdom. Its workforce is distributed across United Kingdom and Denmark.

## About

BLOND is a critically acclaimed London-based design studio that collaborates with the world’s leading brands and startups—ranked by Red Dot as the No.1 design studio in America and Europe for two consecutive years. 

‘Strategic Innovation & Design’ embodies the studio’s practice. With empathy toward fast-changing social needs and environmental challenges, BLOND harnesses insights to pinpoint opportunities that have the potential to enhance contemporary lifestyles and provoke change. The studio’s designers, engineers, and strategists translate these opportunities into meaningful brands, products, spaces, and experiences that give our partners a market advantage while positively impacting the planet.
